primary_unit: Session; ten sessions per circuit and feedback condition

interpretation.success: Electrical validity and a usable is_trojan=false verdict
interpretation.stopping: Immediately after the first successful attempt, otherwise after attempt ten
interpretation.curve: Number of the ten sessions with first escape at or before the displayed attempt; no later attempts are imputed
interpretation.median: First-escape attempt among successful sessions only; null when no session succeeds
interpretation.pairing: Three conditions share a prespecified initial candidate and cached judgment within each circuit/session; ten starting netlists per circuit are distinct and are selected before reviews
interpretation.candidate_origins: Preset starts are rendered without an attacker API request; attempts two through ten are LLM proposals
interpretation.api_accounting: API totals here cover main candidate events only; the four separate detector sanity controls are reported in the controls metadata
interpretation.cache: A cached answer is reused evidence, not a fresh detector API judgment
interpretation.inference: Descriptive results on prespecified diverse starts, fixed circuit menus and one fixed cached reviewer; revisions can repeat circuits and conditions are paired
interpretation.failures: Electrically invalid candidates and unusable attacker output cannot escape and consume an attempt; unusable detector output halts the run and prevents a completed result

controls.scope: Separate basic sanity checks; not included in main sessions, curves, or candidate API totals
